_comment: C0-15 ollama bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（vllm/llama-cpp），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [llamaindex, openai-agents-sdk]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 第二段（models 站 GGUF 索引衔接句）照源译出。

axes.model_access: One-click pulls of open-source models from the official model library (ollama.com/search direct-fetched 200); GGUF and safetensors importable (docs.ollama.com/import direct-fetch verified); the library catalog shifts with listings, not inventoried item by item.
axes.runtime: A local process (CLI + API server, port 11434 by default); the official README states "locally or in the cloud" — a cloud line (Ollama Cloud) exists, details not verified item by item. GitHub 184,165★ (API verified 2026-10-21).
axes.local_files: Model weights and conversation data land on your machine by default; the storage and processing boundaries of the cloud line (Ollama Cloud) not verified item by item.
axes.background: The resident API server carries background inference; official docs have keep-alive/concurrency pages, details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: Official docs include a tool-calling page (as seen in the docs.ollama.com navigation, direct-fetched); MCP support status — no official statement verified.
axes.context: Context length is set by Modelfile/parameters (the Modelfile Reference is in the official docs navigation); cross-session memory — no official statement seen.
axes.permissions: Runs locally with no account needed (the API server listens locally by default); the cloud line requires login, its permission surface not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: getting an open-source model running with one command, wanting an OpenAI-compatible local API, desktop and server alike. Does not fit: maximum throughput/service scheduling (that's vLLM/SGLang's job); item-by-item verification of the cloud line's data boundaries.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the local-endpoint and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no runner-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
The models site's GGUF index framing (llama.cpp as the format source) connects with this dossier's model_access axis.
unknowns:
- Ollama Cloud's data storage and processing boundaries (not verified item by item)
- MCP support status (no official statement verified)
- The full model-library catalog and the commercial terms of each weight (not inventoried item by item)
related: Both open-source model runners: vLLM leads on service-style high throughput, Ollama on single-machine out-of-the-box.
The GGUF ecosystem root Ollama depends on underneath; for fine-grained control use llama.cpp directly.
